title: P2RLN xAPI Profile
description: Declares xAPI activity/verb/profile semantics that a delivered P2RLN activity may emit; learner statements themselves remain outside the portable course package.
rules: P2RLN MUST NOT store learner statement history as course content.
Activity identifiers and declared verbs/profiles SHOULD remain stable across round-trips.
LRS endpoints and credentials are deployment state and MUST NOT be embedded as secrets.
